probes.question: According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics report, what share of the U.S. workforce do freelancers and gig workers make up?
verbatim: freelancers and gig workers comprise nearly 35% of the U.S. workforce

probes.question: In which city is the freelancer Alicia Martinez based?
verbatim: A freelancer based in New York City, Alicia Martinez

probes.question: What did SynthCorp announce in its October 9, 2023 press release?
probes.answer: The launch of a new division dedicated solely to integrating gig workers into their business model
verbatim: In a press release on October 9, 2023, tech giant SynthCorp announced the launch of a new division dedicated solely to integrating gig workers into their business model.

probes.question: What is the Freelance Isn't Free Act intended to ensure for freelancers?
probes.answer: That freelancers receive payment in full and on time
verbatim: aims to ensure freelancers receive payment in full and on time

probes.question: By what year does the Sundial Research Center forecast that nearly half of the working-age U.S. population will have engaged in some form of independent work?
verbatim: A forecast from the Sundial Research Center suggests that by 2025, nearly half of the working-age population in the United States will have engaged in some form of independent work.
